svg.title: THE HARSH TRUTH — latest RSS headlines

g.text: Fashion pulse: New Zealand - August 2026 ◆ Brunello Cucinelli expands retail presence in Shanghai with opening of Casa Cucinelli ◆ Lacoste restages fall/winter 2026 show in Shanghai with Wang Yibo capsule ◆ Only 27 percent of delivery companies state delivery date before checkout ◆ Counterfeit goods in EU: Italy alone accounted for over 70 percent of all detentions ◆ Burberry's Regent Street flagship to be restored and reimagined as Burberry House ◆
